_comment: Issue #57/#84/#109: mouse support canonical. Same near_tactician fixture/opening as hotbar_tab_loop (inn, warrior L1, [Basic Cleaning] innate 1-slot bar, player at (2,3)) so the click-driven proofs below are directly comparable to that script's key-driven ones. Proves: (title) a title-screen row CLICK reaches Continue instead of the keyboard move+confirm -- title_flow's own shape covers the keyboard path exhaustively, this is the cheap mouse variant of the identical outcome. (A) a DISTANT click on dirty_table (5,4) -- Chebyshev distance 3 from (2,3) -- walks to its nearest open CARDINAL approach cell and STOPS, never interacting (exact per-step count + actions_since_sleep in lockstep, never a teleport; issue #109 narrowed the candidate set from 8 neighbors to 4, so this now lands on (5,3) rather than the pre-fix (4,3) -- see that phase's own comment). (B) Tab-priming the bar THEN clicking slot 1 fires the SAME skill_used/accomplishment/toast stream hotbar_tab_loop's confirm press does, AND the click disarms the primed cursor (index:-1 selection event) -- the field-bar-click-disarms-Tab-primed-cursor ruling. (C) an ADJACENT click on Erin faces her + interacts in one click (dialogue_line bark) -- click-interact never needs a prior move. (D) a click on open, unoccupied ground walks there with the exact per-step count pinned. (E) a keyboard press mid-path cancels the path -- player_cell pinned short of the clicked target. (F, issue #84) Esc opens the field pause menu (full ROWS, not combat_abandon's reduced COMBAT_ROWS), a CLICK on Resume closes it via the exact `_confirm()` dispatch Enter uses. (G, issue #84) a second click on Erin (social_talked[erin] already true from C's bark) opens the REAL erin_errand conversation; clicking its options pins the EXACT SAME `dialogue_choice` payload a keyboard arrow-to-N + Enter would emit -- byte-identical dispatch, not a parallel activation path. (H, issue #109) THE DIAGONAL CLICK-TO-INTERACT REPRO: one step off Erin's cardinal neighbor onto a cell that is Chebyshev-1 but DIAGONALLY adjacent to her -- pre-fix, `handle_world_click`'s bare `chebyshev <= 1` gate treated this as 'close enough' and fired `_face_cell`+`interact()` directly, but `interact()`'s `player_cell + player_facing` lookup is cardinal-only and can never resolve a diagonal cell, so the click silently no-opped (repeatable forever, the issue's own presenting symptom). Post-fix, the SAME click instead routes through `_start_click_path_to_adjacent` (now cardinal-neighbor-only): one real step lands back on Erin's cardinal south neighbor, no interact fires on that arrival (the pre-existing 'walk up, stop, never auto-interact' convention every approach-click already proves) -- a SECOND click, now genuinely cardinal-adjacent, is the unchanged branch and is what actually fires the interaction (`dialogue_started` count 1->2, whole-run, since the since-cursor already passed G's own copy of this event).

steps._comment: Issue #84: reach Continue (ROWS[1]) via a mouse CLICK instead of move+confirm -- same outcome (loads the near_tactician fixture via Continue), proven through the click dispatch instead of the keyboard one.

== A: DISTANT prop click stops WITHOUT interacting == dirty_table sits at (5,4); Chebyshev dist from (2,3) is max(3,1)=3, so this is the non-adjacent branch -- issue #109 narrowed the approach-cell candidates to dirty_table's 4 CARDINAL neighbors only ((4,4)/(6,4)/(5,3)/(5,5) -- the pre-fix search also tried the 4 diagonal neighbors and picked (4,3) at 2 steps; that neighbor is gone from the candidate set now, so BFS's nearest open CARDINAL approach cell is (5,3) (3 straight-right steps), and the walk stops there, never interacting.

== B: hotbar CLICK == number key, AND disarms a Tab-primed cursor == phase A's own cardinal-only approach walk already lands squarely on the table's straight-south neighbor (5,3) now (issue #109) -- only the facing bump remains here (blocked down-press turns facing, same idiom hotbar_tab_loop uses), then Tab-prime the bar and CLICK slot 1 instead of pressing confirm.

One-shot disarm: `_activate_field_slot` (the SAME helper the number-key branch calls -- NOT the primed-cursor confirm branch, which orders fire-then-disarm) clears the cursor BEFORE firing the skill -- this selection event lands chronologically FIRST, ahead of skill_used.
== C: click-adjacent = face + interact in ONE click == route to Erin's (7,2) south neighbor, same (7,3) approach hotbar_tab_loop's own keyboard route uses.

== D: click-to-walk on open, unoccupied ground == row y=3 is clear from x=1..14 (the inn's own walls.segments leave it unwalled, and no entity sits on it east of Erin) -- a straight 5-step rightward walk, exact count pinned.

Exact per-step count for the WHOLE run so far (never a teleport): 2 (phase A's approach walk) + 1 (the explicit right-step onto (5,3)) + 2 (phase C's approach to (7,3)) + 5 (this phase's click-to-walk) = 10 real player_moved events.

== E: keyboard press mid-path CANCELS == click a far target back along the clear y=3 row, then a keyboard press lands before the path finishes -- player_cell stops SHORT of [2,3], provably mid-corridor, not teleported to it.

The click-path headless continuation advances exactly one real step per engine frame (see world.gd's _advance_click_path doc comment) -- by the time the injected move_up press lands, the path has taken 3 of its 10 planned steps (12,3)->(11,3)->(10,3)->(9,3); move_up itself is refused ((9,2) is an explicit blocked cell, skeleton_scene.json's inn.blocked list) but that is incidental -- what matters is player_cell is pinned SHORT of [2,3], never teleported there.

== F (issue #84): pause-ROW CLICK == Esc opens the field pause menu (full ROWS, combat_abandon already covers the reduced mid-fight COMBAT_ROWS set with keyboard), then a CLICK on Resume (row_rect(0), the SAME Label `_refresh()`'s '> ' mark reads) closes it through the identical `_confirm()` dispatch Enter uses -- player_cell/actions_since_sleep untouched by Resume.
steps.name: cancel

steps._comment: == G (issue #84): dialogue-option CLICK, byte-identical to arrow-to-N + Enter == back onto (7,3) (Erin's adjacent cell from phase C), a second click on her opens the REAL erin_errand hub this time (social_talked[erin] is already true from C's own bark, so this interact skips the pool line) -- cleaned_the_inn:1 (phase B) hides the [Basic Cleaning] offer, so the visible options are [0] 'I'll take the package.' [1] 'The table situation is handled.' [2] 'Just passing through.'. Clicking option 2 (1-based; index 1) must pin dialogue_choice{index:1} -- the EXACT payload Game.sim.dialogue_choose(_cursor) emits for a keyboard confirm at cursor 1, never a parallel activation.

'cleaned' node: [0] 'Actually - one more thing.' (goto hub) [1] 'All part of the service.' (end:true) -- option 2 (1-based; index 1) ends the conversation cleanly. WIDialogue.choose() emits DIALOGUE_ENDED from INSIDE itself, before wi_game.gd's dialogue_choose() gets to emit DIALOGUE_CHOICE right after -- true for an ENDING pick regardless of keyboard or mouse (pre-existing sim ordering, not a click artifact), so dialogue_ended is waited FIRST and dialogue_choice is confirmed via the whole-log assert (order-independent) rather than a second sequential wait.

== H (issue #109): DIAGONAL click-to-interact repro == step off Erin's cardinal south neighbor onto (6,3) -- Chebyshev-1 from Erin (7,2) but DIAGONALLY (dx=1,dy=-1 from the player's own view), the exact shape that used to silently no-op forever (the bare `chebyshev<=1` gate fired `_face_cell`+`interact()` straight from here, but `interact()`'s cardinal-only `player_cell+player_facing` lookup can never resolve a diagonal cell). Clicking Erin from here now routes through `_start_click_path_to_adjacent` (cardinal-neighbor-only since #109's fix): the only reachable cardinal neighbor of (7,2) is (7,3) itself (both (6,2)/(8,2) sit in the map's own static `blocked` list, and (7,1) is far around them) -- one real step east lands there, and NO interact fires on that arrival (dialogue_started count stays at its phase-G value of 1, whole-run).

THE PROOF: a second click on Erin, now genuinely cardinal-adjacent, is the unchanged branch -- it fires the real interaction (dialogue_started count 1->2), closing the repro: the diagonal-adjacent click no longer no-ops forever, it resolves in exactly two clicks (path, then interact) instead of hanging on the doomed one-click attempt.

'hub' node reopened: phase G's own 'The table situation is handled.' pick already banked reported_cleaning (its own effects array), so THAT option's hide_when now retires it -- visible is down to [0] 'I'll take the package.' [1] 'Just passing through.' (end:true). Option 2 (1-based; index 1) ends immediately in one click; dialogue_choice{index:1} was already logged twice in phase G (its own hub pick AND the 'cleaned' node's own index-1 exit happened to share the same index), so this is the third.
